Docker version 29.7.2, build a7dcaa6

CONTAINER ID   IMAGE     COMMAND   CREATED   STATUS    PORTS     NAMES
/usr/bin/openssl
---
stages:
  - test
  - build

default:
  interruptible: true

automated_tests:
  stage: test
  tags:
    - ke-docker
  image: yiisoftware/yii2-php:8.3-apache
  cache:
    key: composer-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG
    paths:
      - src/vendor/
      - .composer-cache/
  before_script:
    - |
      if ! php -m | grep -qx 'pgsql'; then
        apt-get update
        DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpq-dev
        docker-php-ext-install pgsql
      fi
    - php -m | grep -qx 'pgsql'
    - cd src
    - export COMPOSER_CACHE_DIR="$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.composer-cache"
    - export COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1
    - composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist
    - chmod +x tests/run-automated-tests.sh tests/run-public-api-tests.sh tests/run-admin-api-tests.sh
  script:
    - composer test
  artifacts:
    when: always
    expire_in: 2 days
    paths:
      - src/tests/_output/

browser_tests:
  stage: test
  tags:
    - ke-docker
  variables:
    PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION: "1.60.0"
  # The image version must match @playwright/test so both use the same browser revision.
  image: "mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION}-noble"
  timeout: 20m
  cache:
    key: browser-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG
    paths:
      - src/vendor/
      - .composer-e2e-cache/
      - .npm-cache/
  before_script:
    - |
      apt-get update
      DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        php8.3-cli php8.3-sqlite3 php8.3-pgsql php8.3-gd php8.3-mbstring \
        php8.3-xml php8.3-curl php8.3-zip php8.3-intl php8.3-bcmath \
        composer rsync curl unzip

observation.command: docker --version; docker compose version; docker ps 2>&1 | head; which openssl; echo "---"; cat .gitlab-ci.yml | head -60
